info.description:
The Corvo API issues Brazilian NFS-e (nota fiscal de servico eletronica) through the national system.

## Authentication
Send your key in the `x-api-key` header. Keys are created in the dashboard and come in two environments:

- `corvo_test_...` works on the **test** environment (restricted production of the Receita): invoices have no fiscal value and use the company test certificate.
- `corvo_live_...` works on the **live** environment: invoices are real and each one uses a credit.

A key only sees the data of its own environment. Every route needs a permission (for example `nfse.invoices.issue`) that the key must carry; without it the answer is 403.

## Responses
Successful answers are wrapped: `{ "data": ... }`. Lists are `{ "data": [...], "pagination": { "limit", "hasMore", "nextCursor" } }`: pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` to get the next page. Errors are `{ "statusCode", "code", "message", "details"?, "requestId" }`. Fields are `camelCase`, except in billing, schedules and imports, which use `snake_case`.

## Issuing is asynchronous
`POST /invoices` answers 202 with the invoice queued. Follow it with `GET /invoices/{id}` or the invoice webhooks until `status` is final (`authorized`, `rejected`, `failed`, `cancelled`).

## Idempotency
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header on the routes that accept it. Repeating a request with the same key and body returns the first result; the same key with another body answers 409 `ERROR_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.

## Rate limits
Every answer carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (epoch seconds). When exceeded the API answers 429 with `Retry-After` (seconds).

post.description:
Issues an NFS-e for a company. Issuing is asynchronous: the answer is 202 with the invoice `queued`, and the final result comes by webhook or by polling `GET /invoices/{id}`. In `live`, each accepted invoice reserves one credit. With `options.type` `SCHEDULE` or `RECURRING` nothing is issued now: the answer is the schedule (see Schedules). Send `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe. A test key issues on the restricted-production environment, with no fiscal value.

Permission: `nfse.invoices.issue`.

post.description:
Answers 200 when a queued invoice is cancelled locally, and 202 while the NFS-e cancellation event is processed or when the request is registered on an invoice still being issued (`processing`, with `cancellationRequestedAt` set). `description` (15 to 255 characters) is required. An authorized invoice is cancelled at the Sefin (event 101101) and its credit is not refunded; if a processing emission ends rejected or failed the request is discarded and the reservation is refunded as usual. Repeating the request returns the current state (the first request wins). `retry_pending`, `reconciliation_required` and `manual_review` answer 409 `ERROR_INVOICE_NOT_CANCELLABLE`.

Permission: `nfse.invoices.issue`.

202.description: NFS-e cancellation event is being processed (cancelling), or the cancellation request was registered on an invoice that is still being issued (processing, with cancellationRequestedAt set)

Issues a new NFS-e that replaces an authorized one. Only the service description, the purchase order and the notes can change: for MEI and Simples Nacional the Sefin refuses a substitute that changes the customer, the competence date or the amount (rule E0061). The original is cancelled only after the substitute is authorized; a refusal leaves it authorized. The substitute uses a credit like any issued invoice.

Permission: `nfse.invoices.issue`.

post.description:
Accepts 1 to 50 invoices, for one company or several. Each item has the same fields as POST /invoices plus an optional `idempotencyKey`. Items are validated one by one: an invalid item is returned as `rejected` (with `error.code` and `error.message`) and is NOT saved, while the valid ones are saved together in a single transaction. The response has one result per item, in the order sent (`index`). Send an `idempotencyKey` per item: repeating the batch returns the invoices already saved (`replayed: true`) and only retries the rejected ones. The `Idempotency-Key` header does not apply here. In `live`, each accepted item reserves one credit; items beyond the plan limit are rejected with the limit error. Like POST /invoices, issuance is asynchronous: follow each invoice by id or webhook.

Permission: `nfse.invoices.issue`.

202.description: Accepted: the work continues in the background

400.description: The body is not a list of 1 to 50 invoices (ERROR_VALIDATION)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 batches per minute); Retry-After in seconds

post.summary: Emit up to 50 NFS-e in one request

post.description:
Previews the taxes of an invoice with the same body as `POST /invoices`, without reserving a credit, a DPS number or a document. Future competence dates are limited (15 days by default). A fiscal failure answers 200 with `blocked` and the partial result; 503 (with `Retry-After`) means the tax calculator is unavailable.

Permission: `nfse.invoices.issue`.

404.description: Company not found in the tenant and environment

429.description: Authenticated API rate limit exceeded; Retry-After in seconds and X-RateLimit-* headers

503.description: RTC Calculator unavailable; Retry-After in seconds

post.summary: Calculate taxes before issuing an invoice

post.description:
retry sends the invoice again with the same DPS: the portal is asked for that DPS first, so it never issues a second NFS-e. discard rejects the invoice (refunding its credit) only after the portal confirms the DPS was never registered; if the NFS-e exists the invoice becomes authorized. Invoices not in manual_review are skipped. Follow the result through the invoice webhooks.

Permission: `nfse.invoices.issue`.

202.description: Accepted: the work continues in the background

post.summary: Resolve invoices in manual review (up to 100): retry or discard

status.description: `sent` means queued for e-mail (not proof of delivery). Every `skipped-*` means nothing was sent.

status.description: Subscription status from the payment provider, or `none`.

municipalityCode.description: 7-digit IBGE code of the registered address.

specialRegime.description: Special tax regime (regEspTrib, RTC v1.01): 0 Nenhum, 1 Ato Cooperado, 2 Estimativa, 3 Microempresa Municipal, 4 Notário ou Registrador, 5 Profissional Autônomo, 6 Sociedade de Profissionais. Empty string clears it.

amount.description: Gross amount in BRL, at most 2 decimals.

customer.description: Customer (tomador). Optional — omit or send an empty object for anonymous consumer invoices; the tomador is then omitted from the DPS.

webhookUrl.description: Paste it into the payment platform.

customerSnapshot.description: Null for anonymous consumer invoices (tomador omitted from the DPS).

nfseNumber.description: The NFS-e number, a JSON integer (at most 15 digits, within the safe integer range of JavaScript). The leading zeros of the printed number are not kept.
